findingDetails.title: The release note's system-spec-kit range stops one version short
findingDetails.scopeProof: rg -n 'v2\.12\.41\.0 to v2\.13\.[0-9]\.0' over the twelve scope files returns only line 480; every other skill range on that line matches its SKILL.md version.
findingDetails.case: A reader auditing what v4.0.2.1 contains reads the closing index, sees the system-spec-kit sequence end at 2.13.3.0, and never opens v2.13.4.0, so the release-level summary omits the no-command-file-named-skill.md rule the same merge added.

findingDetails.title: The README promises a health record on every prompt hook without the OpenCode exception
findingDetails.scopeProof: rg -n 'persistAdvisorHookDiagnosticRecord' .opencode/plugins returns nothing, while .skilled/skills/system-skill-advisor/hooks/claude/user-prompt-submit.ts:258 is the only non-test binding; rg -n 'hookHealth' .opencode/plugins also returns nothing.
findingDetails.case: An OpenCode user reads the README, runs one prompt, then advisor_status; the response has no hookHealth section because the plugin never wrote a record, so the README's promise does not hold on that runtime.
